# Sum vs treatment coding
If afex is not told "check_contrasts = FALSE" then it will check and change contrasts to be sum contrasts
For looking at the model estimates for correlations, when using sum contrasts, it's comparing against a grand mean.
Time pre = +1 and post = -1, so the interaction effect is half of the difference in slope between the two, and 
if it's negative, then it means that the post has a larger slow than the pre. 

For ANOVA-style output, the sum contrasts are important.
Have to decide when doing the correlation-like output if treatment makes more sense. Depends on what I want to show.

This should be at least approx step of how to add the model prediction lines to the raw data

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}

pred <- ggpredict(model, terms = c("SciEfficacy_score", "Time"))

p +
  geom_line(data = pred,
            aes(x = x, y = predicted, color = group),
            size = 1.2) +
  geom_ribbon(data = pred,
              aes(x = x, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high, fill = group),
              alpha = 0.2,
              color = NA)

```

```{r}

  filter(
    Time == "post"
  ) %>%
  arrange(

  relocate(
    MasteryGoal_score, labSection, .after = sectionID
  )
```

```{r}
forPCA_byQ<-scaleScores %>%
  filter(
    !(ID == 3830) # very different on PCA 
  ) %>%
  select(
    -starts_with("BelongingPost_")
      , -starts_with("ClassEngagement_")
      , -SC0
      , -(type:ClassEngagement_5)
    )%>%
  mutate(
    across(
    starts_with("Fixed_") & !any_of(c("Fixed_score", "Fixed_score_byAvg")),
    ~ ifelse(is.na(.), Fixed_score_byAvg, .)
    )
    , across(
    starts_with("Growth_") & !any_of(c("Growth_score", "Growth_score_byAvg")),
    ~ ifelse(is.na(.), Growth_score_byAvg, .)
    )
    , across(
    starts_with("SciEfficacy_") & !any_of(c("SciEfficacy_score", "SciEfficacy_score_byAvg")),
    ~ ifelse(is.na(.), SciEfficacy_score_byAvg, .)
  )
  , across(
    starts_with("MasteryGoal_") & !any_of(c("MasteryGoal_score", "MasteryGoal_score_byAvg")),
    ~ ifelse(is.na(.), MasteryGoal_score_byAvg, .)
  )
  , across(
    starts_with("PerformanceGoal_") & !any_of(c("PerformanceGoal_score", "PerformanceGoal_score_byAvg")),
    ~ ifelse(is.na(.), MasteryGoal_score_byAvg, .)
  )
, across(
    starts_with("Interest_") & !any_of(c("Interest_score", "Interest_score_byAvg")),
    ~ ifelse(is.na(.), SciEfficacy_score_byAvg, .)
  )
, across(
    starts_with("BelongingPre_") & !any_of(c("BelongingPre_score", "BelongingPre_score_byAvg")),
    ~ ifelse(is.na(.), SciEfficacy_score_byAvg, .)
  )
  ) %>%
  select(
    !(ends_with("_score") | ends_with("_byAvg"))
    , -labSection
  ) %>%
  filter(
    if_all(where(is.numeric), ~!is.na(.))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sectionID = ifelse(sectionID == "RU02", 0, 1)
  )

forPCA_pre_byQ <- forPCA_byQ %>%
  filter(
    Time == "pre"
  ) %>%
  select(
    -Time
    , -ID
  )
```

## By scale scores
```{r}
forPCA_wide<-scaleScores %>%
  select(
    -starts_with("BelongingPost_")
      , -starts_with("ClassEngagement_")
      , -SC0
      , -(type:ClassEngagement_5)
    )%>%
  select(
    ID
    , sectionID
    , Time
    , ends_with("_byAvg")
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(ID, sectionID)
    , names_from = Time
    , values_from = where(is.numeric)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    if_all(where(is.numeric), ~!is.na(.))
  )
```


```{r}
pca_res_wide <- prcomp(forPCA_wide %>% select(-ID, -sectionID), center=TRUE, scale.=TRUE)
```


How many PCs explain 80-90% variance?
Out to PC4 gets to just about 80% variance
```{r}
summary(pca_res_wide)

n_pcs <- 4
```

Decide number of clusters

Elbow method
```{r}
wss <- numeric()

for (k in 1:10) {
  set.seed(123)
  km <- kmeans(pca_res_wide$x[, 1:n_pcs], centers = k, nstart = 25)
  wss[k] <- km$tot.withinss
}

plot(1:10, wss, type = "b",
     xlab = "Number of clusters (k)",
     ylab = "Total within-cluster sum of squares")

```


Silhouette Method
```{r}
library(cluster)

sil_width <- numeric()

for (k in 2:10) {
  set.seed(123)
  km <- kmeans(pca_res_wide$x[, 1:n_pcs], centers = k, nstart = 25)
  ss <- silhouette(km$cluster, dist(pca_res_wide$x[, 1:2]))
  sil_width[k] <- mean(ss[, 3])
}

plot(1:10, sil_width, type = "b",
     xlab = "Number of clusters (k)",
     ylab = "Average silhouette width")

```


```{r}

  , PC3 = pca_res_wide$x[,3]
```

```{r}
          "PerformanceGoal","Interest","Belonging")

for (v in vars) {
```

```{r}

library(emmeans)

vars <- c("Fixed","Growth","SciEfficacy","MasteryGoal",
          "PerformanceGoal","Interest","Belonging")

for (v in vars) {
  cat("\n====================\n")
  cat("Variable:", v, "\n")
  
  model <- aov(as.formula(paste(v, "~ factor(cluster)")),
               data = change_clusters)
  
  em <- emmeans(model, ~ cluster)
  
  print(multcomp::cld(em, Letters = letters))
}

```
Belonging is decreased in cluster 2 compared to cluster 3
Fixed mindset decreased in cluster 1, did not change in cluster 2 and 4, and is increased in cluster 3
Growth mindset decreased in cluster 3 (diff from 4 + 1). Clusters 2 + 4 were fairly stable. Cluster 1 had an increase in growth mindset (diff from 2 and 3)
Interest decreased in cluster 2 (diff from 4 + 1). Cluster 1 increased
Mastery goals in science decreased in cluster 2 (diff from 4 and 1). 
Performance goals increased in cluster 1, different from the other clusters
Scientific self-efficacy increased in Cluster 1, different from 2 + 3

```{r}
      select(
        ID, labSection
      )
    , by = "ID"
  ) %>%
  arrange(cluster, sectionID, labSection) %>%
  group_by(
    cluster, sectionID, labSection
  ) %>%
  summarize(n())
```

```{r}
  filter(
```

```{r}
  ) %>%
  summarize(
    BelongingPrePostAvg = mean(BelongingPre_score_byAvg_post, na.rm = TRUE)
    , BelongingPostPostAvg = mean(BelongingPost_first6_score_byAvg_post, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

forPCA_change <- forPCA_wide %>%
  mutate(
    Fixed = Fixed_score_byAvg_post - Fixed_score_byAvg_pre
    , Growth = Growth_score_byAvg_post - Growth_score_byAvg_pre
    , SciEfficacy = SciEfficacy_score_byAvg_post - SciEfficacy_score_byAvg_pre
    , MasteryGoal = MasteryGoal_score_byAvg_post - MasteryGoal_score_byAvg_pre
    , PerformanceGoal = PerformanceGoal_score_byAvg_post - PerformanceGoal_score_byAvg_pre
    , Interest = Interest_score_byAvg_post - Interest_score_byAvg_pre
    , Belonging = BelongingPre_score_byAvg_post - BelongingPre_score_byAvg_pre
  ) %>%
  select(
    -(ends_with("_byAvg_pre"))
    , -(ends_with("_byAvg_post"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(sectionID) %>%
  mutate(
    # use the section average for belonging change if missing
    # Retains the ones who took the full intended post-survey, but probably more reflective than their
    # post responses specific to Brain and Behavior
    Belonging = ifelse(is.na(Belonging), mean(Belonging, na.rm = TRUE), Belonging)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(
    if_all(where(is.numeric), ~!is.na(.))
  )

forPCA_change %>%
  filter(
    sectionID == "RU03"
  ) %>%
  summarize(
    BelongingMean = mean(Belonging, na.rm=TRUE)
  ) %>% pull(BelongingMean)
```

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}

vars <- c("Fixed","Growth","SciEfficacy","MasteryGoal",
          "PerformanceGoal","Interest","Belonging")

for (v in vars) {
  cat("\n====================\n")
  cat("Variable:", v, "\n")
  
  model <- mixed(
    as.formula(paste(v, "~ cluster * Time + (1 | ID)")),
    data = cluster_pre_post_clean
  )
  
  # ✅ Print model results (ANOVA table)
  print(model$anova_table)
  
  # ✅ Extract p-values
  p_cluster <- model$anova_table["cluster", "Pr(>F)"]
  p_time <- model$anova_table["Time", "Pr(>F)"]
  p_interaction <- model$anova_table["cluster:Time", "Pr(>F)"]

  
  if (p_interaction < 0.05) {
    cat("\nInteraction significant → simple effects\n")
    print(emmeans(model, pairwise ~ cluster | Time))
    print(emmeans(model, pairwise ~ Time | cluster))
    
  } else if (p_cluster < 0.05) {
    cat("\nCluster main effect → pairwise cluster\n")
    print(emmeans(model, pairwise ~ cluster))
    
  } else if (p_time < 0.05) {
    cat("\nTime main effect → pairwise time\n")
    print(emmeans(model, pairwise ~ Time))
  }

}

```
